verdict: Ads have been paused 27 days; relaunch is the immediate priority.
narrative: Paid advertising has been dark since September 16, meaning no spend, no new paid leads, and no cost-per-lead to evaluate this period. The 4 leads and $106 in spend reflected in the 28-day totals trace entirely to that single active day. Website traffic has begun to soften as a result — sessions are trending down over the last several days — which is the expected pattern when paid channels go quiet. Several foundational build items (conversion tracking connections, landing pages, creative assets, and CRM sign-off) are being completed now so that when ads relaunch, the full stack is in place to capture and attribute every lead cleanly. Once those pieces are confirmed live, paid campaigns will resume and lead volume should recover within the first week of spend.
